codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly enforces mode-based execution blocking. The backend successfully retrieves the mode from persistent configuration, enforces a 403 response on restricted execution endpoints (e.g., hyperliquid/order, hyperliquid/close) when set to 'planning', and provides structured, informative error responses. The configuration loading and save logic handles missing/corrupt keys by defaulting to 'planning', mitigating startup risks.

sharedStateObservations.observation: AGENTS.md specifies that 'Structured error responses with error, mode, and reason fields for mode-related failures' are required for mode-related failures. The backend implementation in main.py (`check_execution_allowed`) correctly uses a dictionary detail object in the 403 error.

The scrutiny-validator-cross-validation feature (which spawned this review) does not explicitly verify that read-only API calls continue to work during planning mode, even though that is a stated requirement in AGENTS.md. However, the worker did add this test case in test_api_mode.py.

summary: The feature cross-planning-mode-safe is implemented correctly, ensuring no live trading can occur in planning mode, while preserving required read-only functionality.
